title: install-report — one registration ping per parsec install (draft v0)
description: Fleet accounting only: an anonymous machine-scoped id minted client-side (~/.parsec/install.json) plus coarse environment facts. Every field is pattern-gated so this path cannot carry raw text, matching the savings-ledger tool/session_id guarantee. Keyless pings are valid — an install exists before onboarding — and a later keyed ping links the account server-side. Purging parsec data deletes the id; a reinstall mints a fresh one.

install_id.description: Random machine-scoped id minted at first report and persisted in ~/.parsec/install.json. Not derived from hardware identifiers; `parsec uninstall`/purge deletes it.

harnesses.description: Harnesses parsec is CONFIGURED to intercept on this machine at report time (claude-code, claude-desktop, codex, opencode, …) — the install-level complement of the per-request ledger `tool` field. May be empty (setup not finished).
